teaser.en: It flowers straight from its trunk and is named after two spirits, Mwanga and Jine, whose ailments it is used to treat.
teaser.sw: Hutoa maua moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina lake, na umepewa jina la pepo wawili, Mwanga na Jine, ambao maradhi yao hutibiwa kwa mti huu.
teaser.dg: Unalavya maruwa dzulu ya kolore, na ukaihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho mbiri, Mwanga na Jine; nkuhumirwa kuphoza makongo ganagorehwa ni pepho hizo.

summary.en: *Mwangajine* is a small forest tree that carries its flowers directly on the trunk. Named after two spirits, it is an important Digo medicine for spiritual ailments, and it is listed as Vulnerable.
summary.sw: *Mwangajine* ni mti mdogo wa msituni unaobeba maua yake moja kwa moja kwenye shina. Umepewa jina la pepo wawili, na ni dawa muhimu ya Kidigo kwa maradhi ya kiroho. Umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable).
summary.dg: *Mwangajine* ni muhi mdide wa tsakani unaolavya maruwage dzulu ya kolore. Ukaihwa kpwa madzina ga pepho mbiri, na ni dawa muhimu ya Adigo ya makongo ga pepho; ukaandikpwa dza *Vulnerable* (uri hatarini).

about.en: *Mwangajine* is a small tree of the custard-apple family. Its most unusual feature is that the flowers sprout straight from the trunk and older branches rather than among the leaves, a habit botanists call cauliflory. Finding a bare trunk dotted with flowers is the surest way to know you have found it.
about.sw: *Mwangajine* ni mti mdogo wa familia ya mitopetope. Sifa yake ya ajabu zaidi ni kwamba maua yake huchipua moja kwa moja kutoka kwenye shina na matawi ya zamani badala ya kuota katikati ya majani, tabia ambayo wataalamu wa mimea huiita *cauliflory*. Ukikuta shina tupu lililotapakaa maua, hiyo ndiyo njia ya uhakika zaidi ya kujua kuwa umeupata.
about.dg: *Mwangajine* ni muhi mdide wa jamii ya *mbokwe* (Annonaceae, jamii ya custard apple). Tabiyaye ya ajabu ni kukala maruwa ganatuluka dzulu ya kolo na pandaze za kare, sio kahi ya makodza; asayansi a mimea anaiha tabiya ihi *cauliflory*. Uchiona kolo rikaodzala maruwa bila makodza, ni dalili ya kpweli kukala ukauphaha.

where.en: It grows in moist coastal forest and evergreen bushland. Being small and growing under the canopy, it is easy to walk past unless it is in flower.
where.sw: Huota katika misitu ya pwani yenye unyevu na vichaka vya kijani mwaka mzima. Kwa kuwa ni mdogo na huota chini ya kivuli cha miti mirefu, ni rahisi kuupita bila kuuona usipokuwa umechanua.
where.dg: Unamera matsakani ga pwani genye chinemi na kpwenye vitsaka vyenye makodza chila wakati. Kpwa sababu ni mdide na unamera photsi ya mihi mikulu, ni rahisi kuutsupa bila kuuona, ela uchikala na maruwa.

uses.en: It is an important medicine for spiritual ailments, used by healers for illness thought to come from the spirits.
uses.sw: Ni dawa muhimu kwa maradhi ya kiroho, hutumiwa na waganga kwa maradhi yanayodhaniwa kuletwa na pepo.
uses.dg: Ni dawa muhimu ya makongo ga pepho, inayohumirwa ni aganga kuphoza makongo ganagoaminika kurehwa ni pepho.

culture.en: Its name joins two spirits: Mwanga, who also gives his name to the river terminalia (*mwanga*), and Jine. A closely related shrub, *mwangajine mlume*, carries the same name, with *mlume* ('male') added.
culture.sw: Jina lake linaunganisha pepo wawili: Mwanga, ambaye pia ametoa jina lake kwa mti wa *Terminalia* wa kando ya mito (*mwanga*), na Jine. Kichaka kinachohusiana nao kwa karibu, *mwangajine mlume*, kina jina hilo hilo, likiongezwa *mlume* ('dume').
culture.dg: Dzinare rinaunganisha pepho mbiri: Mwanga, ambaye dzinare piya ni ra *mwanga* (river terminalia), na Jine. Chitsaka cha ndugu wa phephi, *mwangajine mlume*, china dzina ihiri, na neno *mlume* ('wa chilume') rikaenjerezwa.

names.en: The Digo name is *mwangajine*. No Swahili or English common name has been recorded; botanists know it as *Isolona cauliflora*, a name that also points to its trunk-borne flowers.
names.sw: Jina la Kidigo ni *mwangajine*. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiswahili wala la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanaujua kama *Isolona cauliflora*, jina ambalo pia linadokeza maua yake yanayoota kwenye shina.
names.dg: Dzina ra Chidigo ni *mwangajine*. Takuna dzina ra Chiswahili wala ra Chingereza ririroandikpwa; asayansi a mimea anaumanya dza *Isolona cauliflora*, dzina ambaro piya rinaonyesa maruwage ganagotuluka kpwenye kolo.

conservation.en: *Mwangajine* is listed as Vulnerable on the IUCN Red List. It depends on moist coastal forest, much of which has been cleared.
conservation.sw: *Mwangajine* umeorodheshwa kama Hatarini (Vulnerable) katika Orodha Nyekundu ya IUCN. Unategemea misitu ya pwani yenye unyevu, ambayo sehemu kubwa yake imekwisha kufyekwa.
conservation.dg: *Mwangajine* ukaandikpwa dza *Vulnerable* (uri hatarini) kpwenye IUCN Red List. Unakuluphira matsaka ga pwani genye chinemi, na manji ga matsaka higo gakakatwa.

reason.en: The 'male' mwangajine, another Annonaceae named for the same spirits
reason.sw: *Mwangajine* 'dume', mmea mwingine wa familia ya mitopetope (Annonaceae) uliopewa jina la pepo hao hao
reason.dg: *Mwangajine mlume*, ambao ni Annonaceae yanjina iriyoihwa kpwa pepho zizo.

reason.en: River terminalia, named after the spirit Mwanga
reason.sw: *Terminalia* ya kando ya mito, iliyopewa jina la pepo Mwanga
reason.dg: *Mwanga* (river terminalia), uriohalwa dzina kula kpwa pepho Mwanga.

reason.en: Monodora, a close relative in the custard-apple family
reason.sw: *Monodora*, jamaa wa karibu katika familia ya mitopetope
reason.dg: *Monodora*, ndugu wa phephi wa jamii ya mbokwe (custard apple).

reason.en: Xylopia, another forest member of the custard-apple family
reason.sw: *Xylopia*, mmea mwingine wa msituni wa familia ya mitopetope
reason.dg: *Xylopia*, muhi wanjina wa tsakani wa jamii ya mbokwe (custard apple).
